ideas.pitch: A location-based mutual aid and micro-grant allocation platform using verifiable transparent escrow to distribute neighborhood support funds in Scarborough.
ideas.title: Scarborough Community Local Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning Dispatch pattern by combining practical community utility with robust transaction safety and automated escrow tracking, appealing to judges looking for local social impact.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered predictive transit congestion and incident forecasting dashboard tailored for the TTC and local Scarborough transit routes to help commuters avoid bottlenecks.
ideas.title: TransitFlow AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the hard engineering and forecasting success of top-performing AI incident projects by utilizing statistical regression models to deliver practical, localized predictive intelligence.

ideas.pitch: An AI nutrition and wellness application that maps personalized meal recommendations directly to the inventory and menus of local Scarborough ethnic grocery stores and restaurants.
ideas.title: NutriLocal Scarborough
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the winning formula of the E-Foodiee nutrition assistant by moving beyond generic diet tips to solve a concrete, hyper-local consumer problem.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent sustainability platform designed for local educational institutions to monitor, audit, and optimize energy consumption and waste management across campus facilities.
ideas.title: EcoCampus AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the multi-agent RAG architecture that won the GreenNovation Hackathon, providing judges with a polished, enterprise-ready environmental management tool.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven patient acquisition and trust verification engine optimized for local specialized health clinics to securely manage patient intake, reviews, and trust signals.
ideas.title: CliniqueTrust AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies the proven architecture of the Global-Smile prize winner, focusing on high-value healthcare workflow automation that judges immediately recognize as viable.
